GENERIC_METHODOLOGY_LESSONS: A target defined only on a conditioned subset (e.g. a ratio defined only when a denominator is above zero) can create collider selection.
Compared time windows must have matching weekday composition.
Controls matched on a stratum should be compared within that stratum, and permutation nulls should respect it.
Universe membership at a decision time must not depend on survival after it.
Every threshold, window and percentile is part of the search surface and must be frozen before outcomes.
A null model must be able to generate the card's own observable.
